summary: Wrote a detailed handoff prompt to a gitignored dev directory so a future agent can work on making registry extension Install/unlink operations take effect live without restarting the agent-server.
decisions: Chose to store the handoff prompt at `.gizmo-dev/registry-live-reload-prompt.md` in the gizmo project root rather than in source-controlled paths, because `.gizmo-dev/` is gitignored dev state and won't pollute the repo.
